No. 2139/53 – WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 04, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Ref. No.: THI/LND/L2/ACQVI/92-1 VOL

I, hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7, of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land /servitude which is required for the public purpose mentioned below.

Description of the land to be acquired:- Following allotments of lands containing in total extent of 2.1899 hectares depicted as Lot Nos. from 1 to 37 in preliminary plan No. 2789 dated 17.07.2019 prepared by Senior Survey Superintendent of Matara District for Surveyor General, situated in the village of Nadugala in Grama Niladhari’s Division of Nadugala 2—No. 337 in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thihagoda Matara District. Lot No.01 Name of the land: —; Description: Road; Extent: 0.1945 Hectare.

Lot No. 02 Name of the land: Ihalawatta; Description: Home garden, Permanent building and mixed crop cultivation; Extent: 0.0278 Hectare. Lot No. 03 Name of the land: Ihalawatta and Henegewatta; Description: Home garden, mixed crop cultivation; Extent: 0.0286 Hectare.
Lot No. 04 Name of the land: Henegewatta; Description: —; Extent: —.
Lot No. 05 Name of the land: Henegewatta; Description: Home garden, mixed crop cultivation; Extent: 0.0762 Hectare.
Lot No. 06 Name of the land: Ihalawatta, Henegewatta and Addaragewatta; Description: Barren land; Extent: 0.0229 Hectare.
Lot No. 07 Name of the land: Henegewatta and Pussahena; Description: Home garden, Permanent building and mixed crop cultivation; Extent: 0.1399 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Thihagoda on the 06th day of November 2019 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (In duplicate) on or before the 30th day of October, 2019 the nature of their interests in the land the particulars of their claims for the compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
UMESHA SURANGI MATHARAGE, Divisional Secretary, Thihagoda.
